findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential sandbox escape via dangerous attribute access
 * @description Accessing dangerous attributes like __class__, __subclasses__, __globals__ could allow sandbox escape
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/jinja2-sandbox-escape
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::AttrRead attr, string attrName
where
  attrName in ["__class__", "__subclasses__", "__globals__", "__builtins__", "__import__", 
               "__code__", "__func__", "__self__", "func_globals", "func_code"] and
  attr.getAttributeName() = attrName and
  attr.getObject().getScope().getEnclosingModule().getName().matches("jinja2%")
select attr, "Access to dangerous attribute '" + attrName + "' that could be used for sandbox escape."
findings.hypothesis: Sandbox escape through accessing dangerous attributes like __class__, __subclasses__, __globals__, etc. that could bypass Jinja2 sandbox restrictions

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe code execution in Jinja2
 * @description Using compile, eval, or exec with potentially untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/jinja2-unsafe-code-execution
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 *        external/cwe/cwe-095
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall()
  )
select call, "Use of " + call.getFunction().asExpr().(Name).getId() + "() which could execute arbitrary code if input is not properly sanitized."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe use of compile(), eval(), or exec() functions that could lead to code injection vulnerabilities

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization with pickle or marshal
 * @description Using pickle or marshal to deserialize data can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/jinja2-unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Use of unsafe deserialization function that could execute arbitrary code if data is attacker-controlled."
findings.hypothesis: Check for any use of pickle or marshal deserialization which could be exploited if an attacker can control the serialized data

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition
 * @description File existence checks followed by file operations may be vulnerable to race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/jinja2-toctou
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-367
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode check, DataFlow::CallCfgNode fileOp
where
  (
    check = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["exists", "isfile", "isdir"]).getACall() or
    check = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["exists", "is_file", "is_dir"]).getACall()
  ) and
  (
    fileOp = API::builtin(["open", "read", "write"]).getACall() or
    fileOp = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink", "rmdir", "mkdir"]).getACall()
  )
select check, "File existence check that may lead to TOCTOU race condition if followed by file operation."
findings.hypothesis: Check for time-of-check time-of-use race conditions in file operations
